title: Pharma Schemes: 10+1 Free, TD%, CD% & Landed Cost Dilution

intro.title: Trade Schemes & Landed Cost
intro.subtitle: Bonus free quantities (10+1), trade discount (TD%), cash discount (CD%), and automated landed cost dilution

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 5, Part 3: Pharma Trade Schemes, TD%, CD%, and Landed Cost Dilution. In pharmaceutical wholesale, bonus goods directly impact your net inventory valuation.
On the purchase inward screen, add a line item. If the distributor gives a 10 plus 1 free scheme, enter 10 in Billed Packs and 1 in the Free Scheme column.
Observe the Landed Cost column: MediFlow automatically dilutes your cost per unit by spreading the billed purchase price across all 11 physical units.
Next, configure discounts: enter Trade Discount percentage to reduce the taxable value before GST, and Cash Discount for prompt supplier payment.
Review the dynamic margin calculation. Net landed costs update in real time, guaranteeing exact gross profit tracking when items are dispensed at the counter. Next, Generating Formal Purchase Orders!

outro.takeaway: Landed Cost Dilution: Automatically spread purchase costs over billed plus free scheme packs, compute net margins with TD and CD, and preserve accurate profit accounting.
